name: Missing POD Specialist Dataset
description: Five routed cases for the missing proof-of-delivery specialist: two valid routes that must produce the fixed PROVIDE_POD proposal, and three degraded inputs that must be flagged rather than guessed.

evaluations.name: Canonical missing-POD case resolves with PROVIDE_POD

recordCreated__output.customerReason: Payment is on hold until proof of delivery is provided.

inputs.triageAgent__output__rationale: Customer withholds payment pending proof of delivery; evidence carries the delivery date, signer, and matching quantities.

expectedOutput.evidenceSummary: Delivery evidence shows delivery on 2026-06-18, signed by M. Chen, with shipment quantity 120 matching invoice quantity 120.
expectedOutput.recommendedAction: Provide the delivery date, signer, and matching quantity evidence, and request release of invoice INV-20482 for payment with no financial adjustment.
expectedOutput.emailBody:
Riverbend Retail,

Proof of delivery for invoice INV-20482 confirms delivery on 2026-06-18, signed by M. Chen. The shipment quantity of 120 matches the invoice quantity of 120.

Please release the invoice for payment. No financial adjustment is requested.

evaluations.name: A different missing-POD customer still resolves with PROVIDE_POD and no adjustment

recordCreated__output.customerReason: We cannot locate a signed delivery receipt for this shipment.

inputs.triageAgent__output__rationale: Customer cannot locate a signed delivery receipt; delivery evidence is present and quantities agree.

expectedOutput.evidenceSummary: Delivery evidence shows delivery on 2026-06-18, signed by M. Chen, with shipment quantity 45 matching invoice quantity 45.
expectedOutput.approvalSummary: Approve POD response for Northwind Grocers: delivery occurred 2026-06-18, signed by M. Chen, and 45 shipped matches 45 invoiced. Request release of invoice INV-20915 for payment; no adjustment.

evaluations.name: Absent triage rationale is flagged and confidence drops

recordCreated__output.customerReason: Payment is on hold until proof of delivery is provided.

expectedOutput.evidenceSummary: Delivery evidence shows delivery on 2026-06-18, signed by M. Chen, with shipment quantity 120 matching invoice quantity 120. The triage rationale is missing.
expectedOutput.rootCause: Payment is on hold pending proof of delivery; the delivery evidence supports fulfillment. The missing triage rationale is an input-integrity gap.
expectedOutput.approvalSummary: Approve POD response for Riverbend Retail: delivery occurred 2026-06-18, signed by M. Chen, and 120 shipped matches 120 invoiced. Request release of invoice INV-20482; no adjustment. Note: the triage rationale was not provided.

evaluations.name: A PO-mismatch route into the missing-POD specialist is flagged as a conflict

recordCreated__output.customerReason: Payment is on hold until proof of delivery is provided.

inputs.triageAgent__output__rationale: Purchase order pricing does not agree with the invoiced unit price.

expectedOutput.rootCause: Routing conflict: the customer-stated issue is missing proof of delivery, while the routed dispute type and triage rationale indicate a PO pricing mismatch. No PO pricing evidence is supplied.
expectedOutput.approvalSummary: Approve POD response for Riverbend Retail: delivery occurred 2026-06-18, signed by M. Chen, and 120 shipped matches 120 invoiced. Request payment release with no adjustment. Confidence is reduced because the routed type po_mismatch conflicts with the missing-POD customer reason.

evaluations.name: An empty case packet is reported as a gap instead of being invented

inputs.triageAgent__output__rationale: Routed as missing proof of delivery.

expectedOutput.evidenceSummary: The case packet is empty; no case ID, customer name, invoice, or shipment details were supplied. Triage routed the case as missing_pod.
expectedOutput.rootCause: The empty case packet prevents validation against a specific invoice or shipment, so the missing proof-of-delivery basis cannot be confirmed.
expectedOutput.approvalSummary: Approval requested to provide the POD facts of delivery on 2026-06-18 signed by M. Chen with matching quantities, and request invoice release with no adjustment. The empty case packet lacks case, customer, and invoice identifiers.
